description: This Java class defines enumerations and conversion methods for share account statuses, share purchase statuses, period frequencies, and dividend statuses within the Fineract project.

classes.name: SharesEnumerations
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to convert share account and share purchase statuses, period frequencies, and dividend statuses into EnumOptionData objects for UI or API use.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns ShareAccountStatusEnumData based on an integer or ShareAccountStatusType, representing the status of a share account.

methods.name: purchasedSharesEnum
methods.description: Converts PurchasedSharesStatusType to EnumOptionData for share purchase statuses.

methods.name: purchasedSharesEnum (overload)
methods.description: Converts an integer to PurchasedSharesStatusType and then to EnumOptionData.

methods.name: lockinPeriodFrequencyType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for lock-in period frequency based on an integer or SharePeriodFrequencyType.

methods.name: minimumActivePeriodFrequencyType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for minimum active period frequency based on an integer or SharePeriodFrequencyType.

methods.name: shareAccountDividendStatusEnum
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for share account dividend statuses based on ShareAccountDividendStatusType or integer.

methods.name: shareProductDividendStatusEnum
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for share product dividend statuses based on ShareProductDividendStatusType or integer.
